briefdescription.para: X25519 scalar multiplication.

detaileddescription.para: Computes shared = scalar * point on Curve25519. Callers invoking syn_x25519() directly in Diffie-Hellman protocols MUST verify in constant time that shared_out is not all-zero (RFC 7748 Section 6.1) to reject low-order input points.

briefdescription.para: Derive a public key from a private key.

detaileddescription.para: Computes public = scalar * basepoint (the Curve25519 generator, u=9).

briefdescription.para: X25519 Diffie-Hellman — RFC 7748.

detaileddescription.para: Based on the TweetNaCl approach: 16 × int64_t limbs (16 bits each). Simpler and more auditable than 10-limb donna at the cost of some speed. The entire scalar multiplication takes ~10M multiplies.
On Cortex-M4 @ 64 MHz this is ~2-4 seconds — acceptable since handshakes only happen every ~2 minutes.
